items.headline: Kam Davis propels Liberty to 30-14 victory over Delaware in Conference USA opener
items.description: — Kam Davis rushed for 147 yards and two touchdowns to lead Liberty to a 30-14 victory over Delaware on Friday night in a Conference USA opener for both teams.

items.headline: Virginia bounces back, takes care of business against Delaware with 42-3 win
items.description: — Quarterback Beau Pribula scored five touchdowns, helping Virginia jump out to a two-score lead on its way to a 42-3 win over Delaware on Saturday night at Scott Stadium.
